A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DHA supplementation during the third trimester of pregnancy does not reduce maternal depressive symptoms or improve neurodevelopment of children up to 6 years of age.
DHA supplementation during the last trimester and first 2 months of lactation does not improve the neurodevelopment of young infants or reduce maternal symptoms of depression.
DHA supplementation during the second trimester of pregnancy may be beneficial for the prevention of postpartum depression.

the benefits of DHA for the mother’s health and the baby’s health are not just during pregnancy and breastfeeding.
